status: one-shot boot qualified on Panel0; durable power preflight candidate, real power unqualified

power_preflight.requires: owned C12 boot with completed, archived diagnostic; no retry after failed transaction
power_preflight.archive_before_pid1_request: PREADY.TXT with all six stop results; sync, readback, unmount, final sealed check
power_preflight.proof_limit: PREADY records preflight and intent only; it cannot prove PID1 accepted the request or hardware powered off

owner: one coordinator; generic rcS/rcK must not start the same services
network_failure_policy: offline UI after clean partial-network stop; keep diagnostic infrastructure on UI failure

unverified_requirements: writable user-data mount while global root is read-only
seed defaults once, never overwrite existing preferences on each start
replace bring-up boot-volume policy3 only after saved-volume tests
brightness and volume survive controlled stop/restart/reboot

physical_recovery: opt-in, once per boot, current RNG only, owned daemons, separate immutable outcome
